## What it is

Using publicly available Airbnb data from Salem’s listings and reviews, this project seeks to analyze the effects of various Airbnb characteristics on the pricing and ratings of an Airbnb. Variables of interest included amenities, “key” words mentioned in the reviews, proximity to Salem landmarks, seasonal patterns, overall market trends, and host characteristics. We used linear regression, multiple linear regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors and natural language processing to address these questions.

## What I did

- Conducted exploratory data analysis on 280 Salem Airbnb listings and 21,000+ guest reviews spanning 2011–2025, uncovering a fivefold market growth, seasonal demand patterns, and spatial pricing trends across Salem neighborhoods
- Applied VADER sentiment analysis and TF-IDF keyword extraction to guest reviews, identifying that top-rated listings are characterized by experiential language and personal touches, while lower-rated listings surface physical space complaints
- Translated model findings into dual-lens business recommendations, advising hosts on high-impact amenities and differentiation strategies while guiding guests on how to book smarter in a market where price is a poor proxy for experience quality
